fields.why: This is a descriptive programme evaluation that summarizes order questionnaires and 10- and 60-day follow-up surveys; surveillance/descriptive alone fits best. Adding cross-sectional for the one-time postorder questionnaire is defensible but adds little, since the follow-up surveys are not one-time snapshots.

brief_issues: The brief has no design value for a programme evaluation or monitoring report built on programme questionnaires, so readers choose between surveillance/descriptive, cross-sectional and mixed/other. Both readers apply the level-2 cap correctly: the ranges (45.4% to 13.2%; about 31.0% vs 20.7%) are values set side by side, not computed contrasts.
